title: Compact Project Evidence Record
$comment: Version 1 record_hash recipe: remove record_hash; construct the object in this exact property order: version, evidence_id, task_id, kind, status, claim, summary, observed_at, producer, subjects, references. Producer properties are tool, command. Subject properties are path, role, content_hash. CanonTrail sorts subjects by path and references lexicographically before serialization. Serialize with JavaScript JSON.stringify without spacing, encode as UTF-8, calculate SHA-256, lowercase the hexadecimal digest, and prefix sha256:. Object property order is byte-significant in version 1.

record_hash.description: Self-hash produced by the version-1 ordered JSON.stringify/UTF-8/SHA-256 recipe documented in this schema's $comment and ARTIFACT_PROTOCOL.md.
